purpose: To assist vessel masters in planning port calls by answering questions and checking weather conditions.
audience: Vessel masters, shore-based personnel, and other stakeholders involved in port operations.
scope: The assistant provides information on Rotterdam and Singapore port guides, including pre-arrival notices, pilotage, berthing and mooring, weather limits, waste and bunkering, and crew shore leave. It also checks the current weather at the port to determine if operations are within weather limits.
